audience: Codex plugin authors and app UI builders
candidate_text: Codex app-server plugin responses now include nullable app/template categories from `.app.json`, branding, or app metadata, so plugin detail UIs can group apps without custom lookups. PR: https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/27420
caveats: The category field is nullable and additive.
Do not imply a new plugin install or auth capability.

claims.text: Plugin app and template summaries now carry a nullable category field.
The category can come from local `.app.json`, branding metadata, or remote app metadata.

decision.reason: The protocol addition has a concrete plugin UI and authoring explanation.

evidence_notes: Local and remote plugin metadata now feed category values into plugin responses.
Tests assert category propagation in plugin read/install responses.
next_steps: Let Publisher automation decide whether to reserve or publish this candidate.
